reason: I've had sudden stabbing low back pain since yesterday.
diagnosis: Acute mechanical low back strain with referred right leg pain, suggested by sudden onset after lifting/unloading groceries, pain worsened by movement/cough, minimal pain at rest, and no neurologic, infectious, or cauda equina red-flag symptoms.
keyPoints: Pain character, severity, and aggravating/relieving factors
Radiation to leg and any numbness, tingling, or weakness
Screen for cauda equina: bowel/bladder changes, saddle anesthesia, erectile dysfunction
Red flags for infection/malignancy: fever, weight loss, night sweats, cancer history
Past episodes, trauma, and response to analgesics
Risk factors for serious spinal disease: diabetes, smoking, immunosuppression
